title: scan_findings
description: What a scan session found in a repository. It reads and reports; it changes nothing.

searched.description: What was actually looked at: the paths, the pattern, the command run. One or two sentences.

title.description: One line naming the problem and where it is, as an issue title would.

class.description: The kind of change, using the same words the detector uses.

why.description: The evidence: the library's own message, or the behaviour that differs, and how you know.

tests.description: The tests that cover this site, if any cover it.

confidence.description: certain when a command demonstrated it, likely when the code plainly matches a documented change, unsure otherwise.
